description:
You are the physical security manager at BuildingTech Solutions. An urgent security advisory has been received: RFID cards with serial numbers in the range 0004521820 to 0004521829 (inclusive) were shipped from a manufacturing facility that was compromised. Cards in this range may have been cloned and must be considered stolen.

Your task in the 2N Access Commander system (https://localhost:9443, admin / 2n):

1. Identify every user who currently holds an RFID card with a number in the range 0004521820–0004521829. You are not told which users are affected — you must discover them by inspecting the system.

2. For each affected user: remove the compromised card from their account.

3. For each affected user: assign a replacement RFID card. Use numbers starting from 0004522100, assigning 0004522100 to the first affected user you find, 0004522101 to the second, and so on.

4. Do NOT disable or delete any user account. Affected users must remain active with their new card.
